title: Every package stays in major version 0
situation: The release pull request would have published cratylus and @cratylus/forge as 1.0.0, because two change notes marked breaking changes as major, which the release tool turns into 1.0.0 below version 1.
decision: The operator, 2026-10-13: every package stays in major version 0. A breaking change is released as a minor bump while in 0.x; 1.0.0 is published only when the operator decides the interface is stable. The two notes are marked minor.
